subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
11. A company's wage budget for the last month was based on a standard production
time of 30 minutes per unit and a standard wage rate of ` 50 per hour.

During the last month, it produced 30,000 units. The labour rate variance
was ` 7,500 adverse and the labour efficiency variance was nil.

What is the actual wage rate per unit during the last month?
(A)  ` 50.00
(B)  ` 25.50
(C)  ` 50.50
(D) ` 25.25
(2 Marks)
